statements.text: Neurophenomenology is a research program for the neuroscience of consciousness, proposed by Varela in 1996, that uses first-person data from phenomenologically trained subjects to describe and quantify the large-scale neural dynamics of consciousness. It joins first-person methods, dynamical systems theory and measures of large-scale brain integration.

sources.quote: The paper presents a research programme for the neuroscience of consciousness
neurophenomenology is based on the synergistic use of three fields of knowledge
